lines.1: The entire student council executive committee had assembled in front of the school.
lines.2: 「So why exactly do we have to hold a retreat at school?」
lines.3: 「Hmm. We were originally going to take my cruiser out to an island.」
lines.5: 「It is a long and complicated story, so listen well.」
lines.6: 「Yesterday, I boarded the cruiser to perform some maintenance.」
lines.7: 「But one of the gauges was acting strangely.」
lines.8: 「I thought a good blow would knock some spirit into it, so I struck it.」
lines.9: 「And every gauge on the vessel died! Gaaahahahahaha!」
lines.10: 「If you hit something, Director, of course it will break.」
lines.12: 「So I took out my frustration by reducing it to scrap in one minute.」
lines.14: 「Thus, we will be spending the night at school.」
lines.15: 「What a letdown... Why do we have to sleep at school?」
lines.16: 「Still beats being told to train in the mountains.」
lines.18: 「We will all bed down together in the gym.」
lines.19: 「I will be sleeping in the faculty room, however.」
lines.20: 「...Leo. Boys and girls are all sleeping together.」
lines.24: He was painfully easy to read.
lines.25: 「Sleeping in a group, huh? Yoppi is quite a sight when she wakes up, so this may be difficult.」
lines.27: 「Her blood pressure is so low that getting up is a chore. She drags herself across the floor without even standing.」
lines.29: Every boy present fixed Yoshimi with a fascinated stare.
lines.33: 「Preparing for next weekend's Sports and Combat Festival, as befits the executive committee. The athletics committee has fallen behind because some members are out sick.」
lines.35: 「I'm starting to feel like we got tricked.」
lines.37: 「I will pay for dinner out of my own pocket. Let that make amends.」
lines.38: 「It'd better be good, or I'm not lifting a finger.」
lines.40: 「Seriously?! From a place without a conveyor belt?」
lines.41: 「Indeed. It is a favorite restaurant of mine, and quite delicious.」
lines.42: 「Then let's start working with that sushi as our goal.」
lines.45: 「Could you have some of the sushi made without wasabi?」
lines.47: We had gathered late, so night fell in no time at all.
lines.48: 「It has arrived! A lavish sushi feast. Eat your fill.」
lines.49: 「Eating sushi here would normally be forbidden, but I suppose an event like this merits an exception.」
lines.51: 「Quit stamping your feet with every word.」
lines.56: Everyone's chopsticks shot out at once.
lines.57: 「Would anyone care for my sea urchin?」
lines.59: 「Here, Yoppi. You like conger eel, don't you?」
lines.61: 「In exchange, I will take your fatty tuna, squid, sweet shrimp, and salmon roe.」
lines.64: Yashi steadily polished off her sushi.
lines.66: 「No need. I can finish it all.」
lines.67: 「Come on. Premium tuna is wasted on you, so I'll eat it.」
lines.68: Crab snatched someone else's food with lightning speed.
lines.72: I decided to take a picture for them with my phone.
lines.73: 「The clever move is to steal sushi from Nagomin and Kani-chi's trays while they are distracted.」
lines.76: The Princess flung a piece of salmon.
lines.78: Otome leaped up and caught the flying salmon in her mouth.
lines.81: 「I was ensuring the food did not go to waste!」
lines.85: 「Nothing. I am just going out for some night air.」
lines.87: 「Princess, are you leaving sushi behind? Very well. I will dispose of it.」
lines.89: And in an instant, she disposed of it.
lines.92: Ah. The sushi she had stolen had wasabi on it.
lines.93: She would never want ordinary people to see her taking damage like this.
lines.99: I was glad it did not seem serious.
lines.102: 「Sleeping in a gym with girls! This is the best!」
lines.103: 「Don't try anything weird with the Princess.」
lines.105: 「Hey, where are you going, Subaru? The school gate is that way.」
lines.106: 「I got called in for my night job. The rest is up to you.」
lines.107: With that, Subaru sauntered off into the night.
lines.108: 「Hey, you don't have to go even at a time like this...」
lines.109: 「He can't hear you now. Think he's addicted to it?」
lines.110: 「Hmm... We have to get him to quit someday.」
lines.113: 「We laid out the futons for you.」
lines.116: They were actually making boys and girls sleep in the same room.
lines.117: Still, with fussy Otome around, nothing would happen.
lines.118: 「I am going to give Inori-sensei my good-night greetings. You should all go to sleep.」
lines.119: With that, Otome left the gym.
lines.121: 「And the best part of a school trip is...」
lines.123: 「Absolutely not! If we're doing that, let's all bully Coconut instead.」
lines.125: 「You pantyhose-wearing first-year! Don't those things get sweaty in summer?」
lines.126: 「That's not what you said a moment ago.」
lines.130: The Princess hurled a pillow at me.
lines.131: 「Let us try this custom known as a pillow fight.」
